decision: CRA2 next delivery sequence at Stage 1; not architecture/vendor selection or permission to implement

evidence.claim: Real NeMo check: benign allowed, canonical injection blocked, newline and zero-width variants allowed. 4 probes, 2 expectation misses. Boundary coverage only, not proof of compromise.

Candidate app construction shows no pending queue bound and default chat concurrency one. Live owner app has max instances one, request concurrency four, IAP enabled and zero additional configured app accounts.

TruLens has six same-author development retrieval cases and explicitly does not measure faithfulness/jailbreak resistance. Labels pair incidents with derived postmortems. Existing contract tests remain useful but do not establish broader quality.
Recovery prototype already shows related incidents, graph direction and explicitly unverified declarations. Automated compatibility/reconciliation proof and measured recovery duration are absent.

Code review identified request-only application write audit, incomplete recovery telemetry correlation, live/draft release mismatch and stale mode/network descriptions. Findings C4-C6 state limits and completion conditions.

BMC Helix documents historical outcomes/health/dependency factors and what-if risk analysis; Digital.ai documents risk prediction and a gate. These are vendor capability claims, not CRA2 comparative utility evidence.

UTCP supports several transport plugins including MCP. LangGraph persistence supports checkpointed execution; CRA2 compile() has no checkpointer. Neither proves a platform rewrite improves these review tasks.

flip_conditions: Move a feature earlier if independently observed reviewer benefit outweighs sequencing cost while all required safety gates remain satisfied.
Move durable workflow or a UTCP adapter earlier only when an approved source or long-running job demonstrates a concrete need and passes identical boundary/fault tests.
Revise scope if workload, data permissions or budget changes; never infer invitation approval.
limits: No implemented head-to-head delivery-path or customer-utility measurement. Do not infer COMPARATIVE superiority from presence of a feature or current defect.
The prior TruLens-vs-Ragas verdict is a separate decision and is not changed here.
Source code and observations support correction candidates; priority acceptance and later implementation remain human gates.

options.description: Close C1-C6 gaps in bounded slices, then F1/F2 recovery evidence, F3/F6 controlled ingestion, F4/F5/F7 signals/graph/dataset, with F8-F11 as measured experiments. Start C1 reproduction/fix only after accepted design/plan.
Prioritize uploads, dynamic graph and note/review UI using current regression tests; address C1-C6 as defects arise. Strongest rival for rapid visible product feedback.
Prioritize a UTCP migration and durable agent substrate before new domain features; then integrate recovery and ingestion on the revised platform.

requirements.text: "on this CRA2 and come up with features and corrections required" using ai-native-sdlc
"Keep it owner-only until I test it and approve invites."
Guardrail activity: "Current session only". Ensure NeMo, and try Ragas or TruLens for evals.

"Finish Version 1; then start incident and rollback features". Requested uploads/dataset view, incident history, rollback analysis, deployment-note sentiment, dependency visualization and peer reviews.
This turn produces a Stage 1 intent and findings, not application code or new cloud access. The first proposed implementation slice should be bounded and testable.
Independent customer value, deadline, peak load/SLO, first production data source, current total budget and precise meaning of agent substrate.

smallest_separating_test: Use the same four context probes plus a small blinded set of reviewer tasks (including irreversible rollback and stale graph evidence) on thin prototypes of the candidate paths. Compare critical misses/false blocks, supported findings and time-to-useful-review; require the same access and cost boundary. A protocol-first path must also prove an existing task cannot be met without that change.
